title: Set company OKRs
summary: Implement quarterly OKR framework with company, team, and individual objectives tracked in Linear/Notion.

parts.title: Define company-level objectives
parts.guidance: Use the strategy, current performance, and business constraints to identify the outcomes leadership wants to change during the planning period. Draft objectives and measurable key results with baselines, targets, and accountable owners. Check that each measure can be obtained and that proposed commitments fit the team's capacity. Resolve conflicting priorities with the company decision-maker, leaving a clear account of what the company is pursuing and what it is choosing to defer.

parts.title: Create OKR tracking in Notion
parts.guidance: Create the OKR register in the selected workspace, using Notion when that is the team's home. Give each key result an owner, baseline, target, current value, measurement source, and review cadence. Keep progress data separate from commentary about risks or confidence. Enter the agreed plan and make it easy to see missing updates, then show owners how to update their result and flag a proposed target change without overwriting its history.

parts.title: Teams define team OKRs
parts.guidance: Have each team identify outcomes it can influence that contribute to the company objectives. Check proposed key results for clear ownership, a measurable baseline, and realistic capacity. Resolve dependencies with other teams before treating a target as a commitment, and identify necessary operational work outside the OKRs. Publish the team plan with its owners and measures so the next review can examine actual progress and the assumptions behind it.

parts.title: Create Linear projects for key results
parts.guidance: Identify the initiatives expected to influence each key result and link existing projects before creating new ones. In the team's tracker, including Linear when selected, connect each initiative to its key result and accountable owner. Define the deliverable and expected contribution so teams can decide what work is worth doing. Review completed project work alongside the measured result, and use the gap between expected and actual progress to decide what to try next.

parts.title: Send kickoff to team
parts.guidance: Prepare the kickoff around the agreed company and team objectives, the planning period, and the review rhythm. Explain what changes for current work, who owns each result, and where questions or priority conflicts go. Have the planning lead confirm the final plan and announcement before sending it to the team. Link the OKR register and collect unresolved questions there so answers and later decisions remain attached to the plan people are following.

metadata.supportReason: Linear/Notion APIs support project and page creation. OKR definition and alignment need human facilitation.
